avis.titre: Best Facial Scrub on the Market!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the scrub since I was a teenager. I’m 52. I’ve tried others. They irritated my skin. I’ve broke out this face scrub truly is the best scrub. My skin is so soft. It cleans it thoroughly, It doesn’t dry me out. I love it!

I ONLY use this at NIGHT. If I use in the morning, my skin is red in some places and totally washed out in others. Makes my face look weird. But if I use it at night, my face has that glow like it does with all the other St. Ives face wash I've used so far (the pink, blackhead/green, and regular apricot. Altho I also feel since they have rebranded the pink and blackhead/green face wash they are not as good 🫤) aNyWaY I like this stuff! I tried to be very gentle with it during a morning use, still had the same effect of making my face both red and washed out. But nightly use is amazing!
